sloka: स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य निर्भयेनान्तरात्मना ।तृणीकृत्य च तद्रक्षः सोऽब्रवीत्परुषं वचः ।। ६-४०-९।।
transliteration: sthitvā muhūrtaṁ samprekṣya nirbhayenāntarātmanā ।tṛṇīkṛtya ca tadrakṣaḥ so'bravītparuṣaṁ vacaḥ ।। 6-40-9।।

translations.english: For a moment he stood looking at the ogre fearlessly in his mind and treating him like straw spoke harsh words.
